author: Solao
description: Character portrait and sheet for Dragonball Infinity, off char.vitals and score.
name: Portrait
script: plugin = { id = "dbi-portrait", name = "Portrait", version = "0.1.0", author = "Solao", description = "Character portrait and sheet for Dragonball Infinity, off char.vitals and score.", settings = { saveState = true }, } -- Two sources, because neither is enough on its own: -- -- char.vitals hit, max_hit, energy, max_energy, basepl, pl. Live, pushed, -- and the only thing that keeps the bars honest while you fight. -- score race, sex, age, stats, armour, kills, everything else. Only -- arrives when asked for, so it is parsed and kept. -- -- Nothing here gags anything. The score block stays in the scroll exactly as -- the MUD sent it. local VERSION = "0.1.0" -- Same reload guard as Scouter: the client does not reliably tear down a -- previous load's timers, so each load stamps a token and an older tick retires. local INSTANCE = tostring(os.time()) .. "-" .. tostring(math.random(100000, 999999)) local tickTimer = nil local AVATAR_BASE = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SeanStoves/dbinfinity-mudforge/HEAD/img/avatars" local INK = "#e8e2d4" local INK_DIM = "#8a8272" local PANEL_BG = "#0d0b07" local PANEL_FILL = "#171208" local PANEL_RGB = "13,11,7" local FILL_RGB = "23,18,8" local GOLD = "#ffb02e" -- the gi local KI = "#4fc3ff" -- energy local BLOOD = "#d64545" -- lifeforce local ALERT = "#ff8a3d" local FONT_FALLBACK = "ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace" local termFamily = "" local termSize = 13 local widget = nil local panelAlpha = 1 local view = "portrait" -- or "sheet" local avatarUrl = "" -- override, per character local lastError = "none" -- char.vitals, owned copy local vit = nil -- everything parsed out of score local sc = {} local scoreSeen = false -- score arrives as a block; these bound it local inScore = false local scoreLines = 0 local SCORE_MAX = 60 -- The rank and the name sit ABOVE the block's first rule, so by the time -- 'STRENGTH:' identifies the block they have already gone past. Three lines of -- look-behind is enough to reach back for them. local recent = { "", "", "" } local nameOverride = "" -- Core.Hello and the supports Add belong to whichever of our plugins loads -- first. Add merges rather than replaces, and 'Map 1' turns on char stats as -- well, so one negotiation covers both panels -- but each has to be able to do -- it alone. A global-scope variable is the only state two plugins share. local HELLO_KEY = "dbi-gmcp-hello" local HELLO_WINDOW = 30 local negoConnected = false local negoTick = 0 local negoDone = false local primed = false ---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- value hygiene, same reasons as Scouter ---------------------------------------------------------------------- local function safeNum(v) local n = tonumber(v) if n == nil then return nil end if n ~= n then return nil end return n end local function numOr(v, fallback) local n = safeNum(v) if n then return n end return fallback end -- "9,925" and "3,130" are how this MUD writes numbers local function commaNum(s) if type(s) ~= "string" then return nil end return safeNum((s:gsub(",", ""))) end local function trimBoth(s) return (tostring(s or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")) end local function escapeHtml(s) local out = tostring(s or "") out = out:gsub("&", "&") out = out:gsub("<", "<") out = out:gsub(">", ">") out = out:gsub('"', """) return out end -- race and sex become part of a filename and a URL, so anything that is not -- plainly alphanumeric is folded away rather than trusted. local function slug(s) local out = tostring(s or ""):lower():gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-"):gsub("^%-+", ""):gsub("%-+$", "") return out end ---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- score -- -- Fixed-format, but read by label and capture throughout. Offset arithmetic on -- strings is unreliable in this runtime -- it advanced by zero once and cost an -- evening -- so nothing here counts characters. ---------------------------------------------------------------------- local function field(line, label, pattern) if not line:find(label, 1, true) then return nil end return line:match(pattern) end -- STRENGTH: 52( 52.41) | SPEED: 57( 57.61) local function statPair(line, a, b) local av, ar = line:match(a .. ":%s*(%d+)%(%s*([%d%.]+)%)") local bv, br = line:match(b .. ":%s*(%d+)%(%s*([%d%.]+)%)") if av then sc[slug(a)] = safeNum(av) sc[slug(a) .. "-real"] = safeNum(ar) end if bv then sc[slug(b)] = safeNum(bv) sc[slug(b) .. "-real"] = safeNum(br) end end local function parseScoreLine(line) statPair(line, "STRENGTH", "SPEED") statPair(line, "SPIRIT", "FORTITUDE") local race = field(line, "RACE", "RACE%s*:%s*([%a%s%-]-)%s*|") if race then sc.race = trimBoth(race) sc.hours = safeNum(line:match("Hours:%s*(%d+)")) sc.sex = trimBoth(line:match("Sex:%s*(%a+)") or "") sc.age = safeNum(line:match("Age:%s*(%d+)")) end local armor = field(line, "Armor", "Armor%s*:%s*(.-)%s*$") if armor then sc.armor = trimBoth(armor) end local align = line:match("Align%s*:%s*([%+%-]?%d+)") if align then sc.align = safeNum(align) end local pos = line:match("Position%s*:%s*(%a+)") if pos then sc.position = pos end local rpp = line:match("RPP%s*:%s*(%b())") if rpp then sc.rpp = rpp end local lf = line:match("LifeForce:%s*%[([%d%.]+)%]") if lf then sc.lifeforce = safeNum(lf) end local en, enMax = line:match("Energy:%s*%[([%d,]+)/([%d,]+)%]") if en then sc.energy = commaNum(en) sc.energyMax = commaNum(enMax) end local zeni = line:match("ZENI:%s*([%d,]+)") if zeni then sc.zeni = commaNum(zeni) end local basepl = line:match("BASE POWERLEVEL:%s*([%d,]+)") if basepl then sc.basepl = commaNum(basepl) end local currpl = line:match("CURR POWERLEVEL:%s*([%d,]+)") if currpl then sc.pl = commaNum(currpl) end local gainpl = line:match("GAINED PL SINCE LOGON:%s*([%d,]+)") if gainpl then sc.gainedPl = commaNum(gainpl) end local gainki = line:match("GAINED KI SINCE LOGON:%s*([%d,]+)") if gainki then sc.gainedKi = commaNum(gainki) end local items, itemsMax = line:match("Items%s*:%s*(%d+)/(%d+)") if items then sc.items = safeNum(items) sc.itemsMax = safeNum(itemsMax) end local wt, wtMax = line:match("Weight:%s*(%d+)/(%d+)") if wt then sc.weight = safeNum(wt) sc.weightMax = safeNum(wtMax) end local style = line:match("Style%s*:%s*(%a+)") if style then sc.style = style end for label, key in pairs({ PKills = "pkills", PDeaths = "pdeaths", MKills = "mkills", MDeaths = "mdeaths", SparWins = "sparwins", SparLoss = "sparloss", SplitWins = "splitwins", SplitLoss = "splitloss", Crits = "crits", Tokens = "tokens" }) do local v = line:match(label .. "%s*:?%s*%[(%d+)%]") if v then sc[key] = safeNum(v) end end local eq = line:match("EQ%s+PL Gains Bonus:%s*([%d%.]+)") if eq then sc.eqBonus = safeNum(eq) end local created = field(line, "Created", "Created%s*:%s*(.-)%s*$") if created then sc.created = trimBoth(created) end end -- The block opens on the stats rule and closes on CurrTime. SCORE_MAX is the -- ceiling that stops a machine that never sees the end from reading forever. -- The second line of score is " " -- "Solao Bajiuik says -- no." Two words of name, then whatever the player set as a title, with no -- delimiter between them. Capped at two, and stops early on a lowercase word so -- a character with no surname keeps their title intact rather than losing its -- first word to the name. local function nameFrom(line) local out = {} for word in line:gmatch("%S+") do if #out >= 2 or not word:match("^%u") then break end out[#out + 1] = word end if #out == 0 then return nil, nil, nil end local full = table.concat(out, " ") return out[1], out[2], trimBoth(line:sub(#full + 1)) end local function readHeader() local rank = trimBoth(recent[1]):gsub(",%s*$", "") if rank ~= "" and not rank:find("—", 1, true) then sc.rank = rank end -- First name is the one that matters; the surname is kept because it is -- there, and shows up on the sheet rather than in the headline. local first, last, title = nameFrom(trimBoth(recent[2])) if first then sc.first = first sc.last = last sc.title = title sc.name = first if last then sc.name = first .. " " .. last end end if nameOverride ~= "" then sc.first = nameOverride sc.name = nameOverride end end local function feedScore(clean) if inScore then scoreLines = scoreLines + 1 parseScoreLine(clean) if clean:find("CurrTime", 1, true) or scoreLines > SCORE_MAX then inScore = false scoreSeen = true return true end return false end if clean:find("STRENGTH:", 1, true) then inScore = true scoreLines = 1 readHeader() parseScoreLine(clean) return false end -- look-behind, oldest first; only useful while outside a block recent[1] = recent[2] recent[2] = recent[3] recent[3] = clean return false end ---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- gmcp ---------------------------------------------------------------------- local function acceptVitals(data) local src = data if type(src) ~= "table" then src = getGMCPData("char.vitals") end if type(src) ~= "table" then return false end vit = { hit = safeNum(src.hit), maxHit = safeNum(src.max_hit), energy = safeNum(src.energy), maxEnergy = safeNum(src.max_energy), basepl = safeNum(src.basepl), pl = safeNum(src.pl), } negoDone = true return true end -- Whichever of our plugins connects first does the handshake. Add merges, and -- 'Map 1' brings char stats with it, so one negotiation serves both panels. -- The stamp is app-wide so the other plugin can see it. local function ensureGmcp() local last = safeNum(getVariable(HELLO_KEY, "global")) local now = os.time() if last and (now - last) < HELLO_WINDOW then return false end setVariable(HELLO_KEY, tostring(now), "global") sendGMCP('Core.Hello { "client": "MudForge", "version": "1.2.2035" }') sendGMCP('Core.Supports.Add ["Map 1"]') return true end ---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- typography, matching Scouter: follow the terminal rather than dictate ---------------------------------------------------------------------- local function readTerminalFont() local ok, fn = pcall(function() return _G["getTerminalFont"] end) if not ok or type(fn) ~= "function" then return end local good, f = pcall(fn) if not good or type(f) ~= "table" then return end if type(f.family) == "string" and f.family ~= "" then termFamily = f.family:gsub("[;}<>]", "") end local n = safeNum(f.size) if n and n >= 6 and n <= 72 then termSize = math.floor(n) end end local function chromeFont() if termFamily ~= "" then return termFamily .. "," .. FONT_FALLBACK end return FONT_FALLBACK end local function barSize() return math.max(7, math.floor(termSize * 0.60)) end local function bodySize() return math.max(9, math.floor(termSize * 0.82)) end ---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- rendering ---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- CSS backgrounds rather than <img>: an avatar that 404s leaves an empty frame -- instead of a broken-image glyph, which is the failure people actually get. local function avatarCss() local url = avatarUrl if url == "" then local race = slug(sc.race) local sex = slug(sc.sex) if race == "" then url = AVATAR_BASE .. "/generic.png" elseif sex == "" then url = AVATAR_BASE .. "/" .. race .. ".png" else url = AVATAR_BASE .. "/" .. race .. "-" .. sex .. ".png" end end -- Layered: the race's art, then generic, then a gradient that always -- resolves. Until any art exists at all the frame still reads as a -- portrait rather than an empty box, which is what a 404 would otherwise -- look like. return ".dbi-port .face{background-image:url(\"" .. url .. "\")," .. "url(\"" .. AVATAR_BASE .. "/generic.png\")," .. "radial-gradient(70% 60% at 50% 35%,#3a2a12 0%,#140f07 70%);}" end local function css() local a = panelAlpha return "<style>" .. ".dbi-port{position:relative;height:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:8px;" .. "display:flex;flex-direction:column;container-type:inline-size;" .. "background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(" .. FILL_RGB .. "," .. (a * 0.95) .. ") 0%," .. "rgba(" .. PANEL_RGB .. "," .. a .. ") 70%);" .. "color:" .. INK .. ";overflow:hidden;font-family:" .. chromeFont() .. ";}" .. ".dbi-port .bar{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;margin-bottom:6px;" .. "font-size:" .. barSize() .. "px;letter-spacing:0.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:" .. GOLD .. ";}" .. ".dbi-port .bar .ttl{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;" .. "text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}" .. ".dbi-port .tb{flex:0 0 auto;font-size:" .. barSize() .. "px;letter-spacing:0.1em;" .. "text-transform:uppercase;padding:2px 5px;border-radius:2px;" .. "border:1px solid " .. INK_DIM .. ";color:" .. INK_DIM .. ";" .. "cursor:pointer;user-select:none;white-space:nowrap;}" .. ".dbi-port .tb:hover{color:" .. INK .. ";border-color:" .. GOLD .. ";}" .. ".dbi-port .tb.on{color:" .. GOLD .. ";border-color:" .. GOLD .. ";background:rgba(255,176,46,0.12);}" .. ".dbi-port .body{flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;overflow:auto;}" .. ".dbi-port .face{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;border-radius:4px;" .. "background-size:cover;background-position:center top;background-repeat:no-repeat;" .. "border:1px solid rgba(255,176,46,0.35);box-shadow:inset 0 -30px 40px rgba(13,11,7,0.85);}" .. ".dbi-port .who{margin-top:6px;font-size:" .. bodySize() .. "px;line-height:1.45;}" .. ".dbi-port .who .nm{color:" .. GOLD .. ";font-weight:700;}" .. ".dbi-port .who .sub{color:" .. INK_DIM .. ";}" .. ".dbi-port .meter{margin-top:5px;font-size:" .. barSize() .. "px;" .. "letter-spacing:0.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:" .. INK_DIM .. ";}" .. ".dbi-port .track{height:7px;margin-top:2px;border-radius:3px;" .. "background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);overflow:hidden;}" .. ".dbi-port .fill{height:100%;border-radius:3px;}" .. ".dbi-port .fill.lf{background:" .. BLOOD .. ";}" .. ".dbi-port .fill.ki{background:" .. KI .. ";}" .. ".dbi-port .pl{margin-top:7px;font-size:" .. bodySize() .. "px;}" .. ".dbi-port .pl b{color:" .. GOLD .. ";}" .. ".dbi-port table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:" .. bodySize() .. "px;}" .. ".dbi-port td{padding:1px 0;vertical-align:top;}" .. ".dbi-port td.k{color:" .. INK_DIM .. ";white-space:nowrap;padding-right:8px;}" .. ".dbi-port td.v{text-align:right;white-space:nowrap;}" .. ".dbi-port .sec{margin:8px 0 3px;font-size:" .. barSize() .. "px;letter-spacing:0.16em;" .. "text-transform:uppercase;color:" .. GOLD .. ";border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,176,46,0.25);}" .. ".dbi-port .idle{padding:14px 6px;font-size:" .. bodySize() .. "px;line-height:1.7;color:" .. INK_DIM .. ";}" .. ".dbi-port .idle b{color:" .. ALERT .. ";}" .. avatarCss() .. "</style>" end local function meter(label, cur, max, cls) if not cur or not max or max <= 0 then return "" end local pct = math.floor((cur / max) * 100 + 0.5) if pct < 0 then pct = 0 end if pct > 100 then pct = 100 end return '<div class="meter">' .. label .. " " .. cur .. " / " .. max .. '<div class="track"><div class="fill ' .. cls .. '" style="width:' .. pct .. '%"></div></div></div>' end local function row(k, v) if v == nil or v == "" then return "" end return '<tr><td class="k">' .. escapeHtml(k) .. '</td><td class="v">' .. escapeHtml(tostring(v)) .. "</td></tr>" end local function portraitBody() local out = '<div class="face"></div>' local sub = {} if sc.race and sc.race ~= "" then sub[#sub + 1] = sc.race end if sc.sex and sc.sex ~= "" then sub[#sub + 1] = sc.sex end if sc.age then sub[#sub + 1] = sc.age .. "y" end out = out .. '<div class="who"><span class="nm">' .. escapeHtml(sc.first or "Unknown") .. "</span>" if sc.rank and sc.rank ~= "" then out = out .. '<br><span class="sub">' .. escapeHtml(sc.rank) .. "</span>" end if #sub > 0 then out = out .. '<br><span class="sub">' .. escapeHtml(table.concat(sub, " · ")) .. "</span>" end out = out .. "</div>" -- vitals prefer GMCP: it is pushed, score is a snapshot from whenever you -- last typed it local hit, maxHit, en, maxEn = nil, nil, nil, nil if vit then hit, maxHit, en, maxEn = vit.hit, vit.maxHit, vit.energy, vit.maxEnergy end if not hit and sc.lifeforce then hit, maxHit = math.floor(sc.lifeforce * 100), 10000 end if not en then en, maxEn = sc.energy, sc.energyMax end out = out .. meter("Lifeforce", hit, maxHit, "lf") out = out .. meter("Energy", en, maxEn, "ki") local pl = (vit and vit.pl) or sc.pl local base = (vit and vit.basepl) or sc.basepl if pl then out = out .. '<div class="pl">PL <b>' .. escapeHtml(tostring(pl)) .. "</b>" if base and base ~= pl then out = out .. '<span class="sub"> / base ' .. escapeHtml(tostring(base)) .. "</span>" end out = out .. "</div>" end if sc.zeni or sc.align then out = out .. '<table>' .. row("Zeni", sc.zeni) .. row("Align", sc.align) .. "</table>" end return out end local function sheetBody() if not scoreSeen then return '<div class="idle">no score read yet<br><br>type <b>score</b> and it fills in</div>' end -- the surname and title live here rather than in the headline, which is -- the first name alone local out = '<div class="sec">who</div><table>' .. row("Name", sc.name) .. row("Surname", sc.last) .. row("Title", sc.title) .. row("Rank", sc.rank) .. row("Race", sc.race) .. row("Sex", sc.sex) .. row("Age", sc.age) .. "</table>" out = out .. '<div class="sec">stats</div><table>' .. row("Strength", sc.strength) .. row("Speed", sc.speed) .. row("Spirit", sc.spirit) .. row("Fortitude", sc.fortitude) .. "</table>" out = out .. '<div class="sec">body</div><table>' .. row("Armor", sc.armor) .. row("Position", sc.position) .. row("Style", sc.style) .. row("Items", sc.items and (sc.items .. "/" .. tostring(sc.itemsMax))) .. row("Weight", sc.weight and (sc.weight .. "/" .. tostring(sc.weightMax))) .. "</table>" out = out .. '<div class="sec">record</div><table>' .. row("Player kills", sc.pkills) .. row("Player deaths", sc.pdeaths) .. row("Mob kills", sc.mkills) .. row("Mob deaths", sc.mdeaths) .. row("Spar W/L", sc.sparwins and (sc.sparwins .. " / " .. tostring(sc.sparloss))) .. row("Split W/L", sc.splitwins and (sc.splitwins .. " / " .. tostring(sc.splitloss))) .. row("Crits", sc.crits) .. row("Tokens", sc.tokens) .. "</table>" out = out .. '<div class="sec">session</div><table>' .. row("PL gained", sc.gainedPl) .. row("Ki gained", sc.gainedKi) .. row("EQ bonus", sc.eqBonus and (sc.eqBonus .. "%")) .. row("RPP", sc.rpp) .. row("Hours", sc.hours) .. row("Created", sc.created) .. "</table>" return out end local function render() if not widget then return end readTerminalFont() local inner = "" if view == "sheet" then inner = sheetBody() elseif scoreSeen or vit then inner = portraitBody() else inner = '<div class="idle">waiting on the character<br><br>' .. "type <b>score</b> to fill this in</div>" end local gear = "⚙" local on = "" if view == "sheet" then gear = "◀ back" on = " on" end setWidgetProperty(widget, "content", css() .. '<div class="dbi-port">' .. '<div class="bar"><span class="ttl">' .. escapeHtml(sc.name or "Portrait") .. "</span>" .. '<span class="tb' .. on .. '" data-mud-action="view" title="character sheet">' .. gear .. "</span>" .. '<span class="tb" data-mud-action="close">hide</span></div>' .. '<div class="body">' .. inner .. "</div>" .. "</div>") end local function safeRender() local ok, err = pcall(render) if not ok then lastError = tostring(err) print("[Portrait] render error: " .. lastError) end end ---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- widget ---------------------------------------------------------------------- local function saveSettings() setVariable("view", view) setVariable("avatarUrl", avatarUrl) setVariable("panelAlpha", tostring(panelAlpha)) setVariable("nameOverride", nameOverride) end local function applyAlpha() if not widget then return end pcall(function() setWidgetAppearance(widget, { backgroundOpacity = panelAlpha }) end) end local function makeWidget() widget = createWidget({ type = "html", name = "portrait", title = "Portrait", position = { x = 60, y = 90 }, size = { width = 240, height = 420 }, appearance = { showTitleBar = false, autoHideSettingsCog = true }, }) setWidgetAppearance(widget, { backgroundColor = PANEL_BG, backgroundOpacity = panelAlpha, borderColor = GOLD, borderWidth = 2, borderRadius = 10, borderGradient = "linear-gradient(135deg," .. GOLD .. ",#8a4b00 70%,#2a1600)", borderShadow = "0 0 18px 3px rgba(255,176,46,0.25)", }) -- registerWidgetEvent appends, so a reload would stack a second handler pcall(function() unregisterWidgetEvent(widget, "action") end) registerWidgetEvent(widget, "action", function(data) if type(data) ~= "table" then return end local act = tostring(data.action or "") if act == "view" then if view == "sheet" then view = "portrait" else view = "sheet" end saveSettings() safeRender() elseif act == "close" then hideWidget(widget) end end) safeRender() end ---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- diagnostics, in its own function -- Lua 5.1 caps a function at 60 upvalues -- and the command handler is where that ceiling gets hit ---------------------------------------------------------------------- local function printDiag() print("[Portrait] version " .. VERSION .. " instance=" .. INSTANCE) print("[Portrait] connected=" .. tostring(negoConnected) .. " vitalsSeen=" .. tostring(vit ~= nil) .. " scoreSeen=" .. tostring(scoreSeen) .. " parsing=" .. tostring(inScore)) if vit then print("[Portrait] vitals hit=" .. tostring(vit.hit) .. "/" .. tostring(vit.maxHit) .. " energy=" .. tostring(vit.energy) .. "/" .. tostring(vit.maxEnergy) .. " pl=" .. tostring(vit.pl) .. " base=" .. tostring(vit.basepl)) end print("[Portrait] first=" .. tostring(sc.first) .. " last=" .. tostring(sc.last) .. " race=" .. tostring(sc.race) .. " sex=" .. tostring(sc.sex) .. " age=" .. tostring(sc.age)) print("[Portrait] stats str=" .. tostring(sc.strength) .. " spd=" .. tostring(sc.speed) .. " spi=" .. tostring(sc.spirit) .. " for=" .. tostring(sc.fortitude)) print("[Portrait] avatar=" .. (avatarUrl ~= "" and avatarUrl or "(by race)") .. " view=" .. view .. " helloStamp=" .. tostring(getVariable(HELLO_KEY, "global"))) print("[Portrait] lastError=" .. lastError) end ---------------------------------------------------------------------- -- lifecycle ---------------------------------------------------------------------- function init() readTerminalFont() local v = getVariable("view") if v == "sheet" then view = "sheet" end local au = getVariable("avatarUrl") if type(au) == "string" then avatarUrl = au end local pa = safeNum(getVariable("panelAlpha")) if pa and pa >= 0 and pa <= 1 then panelAlpha = pa end local no = getVariable("nameOverride") if type(no) == "string" then nameOverride = no end makeWidget() onGMCPUpdate("char.vitals", function(data) local ok, err = pcall(function() if acceptVitals(data) then safeRender() end end) if not ok then print("[Portrait] vitals error: " .. tostring(err)) end end) setVariable("instance", INSTANCE) negoConnected = true tickTimer = addTimer(1000, function() if getVariable("instance") ~= INSTANCE then if tickTimer then removeTimer(tickTimer) end return end if not negoConnected then return end negoTick = negoTick + 1 -- staggered a second behind Scouter so its stamp is already down and -- only one Core.Hello goes out when both are installed if negoTick == 3 then ensureGmcp() end -- one unsolicited 'score', to fill the panel at login if negoTick == 6 and not primed then primed = true send("score") end end, true) registerCommand("portrait", function(args) local cmd = trimBoth(tostring(args or "")) local low = cmd:lower() if low == "show" then showWidget(widget) safeRender() elseif low == "hide" then hideWidget(widget) elseif low == "sheet" then view = "sheet" saveSettings() safeRender() elseif low == "portrait" then view = "portrait" saveSettings() safeRender() elseif low:sub(1, 7) == "avatar " then local url = trimBoth(cmd:sub(8)) if url == "clear" then avatarUrl = "" echo("[Portrait] back to the race avatar.", GOLD) elseif url:sub(1, 8) == "https://" then avatarUrl = url echo("[Portrait] avatar set.", GOLD) else echo("[Portrait] avatar takes an https:// url, or 'clear'.", "#ff6666") return end saveSettings() safeRender() elseif low:sub(1, 8) == "opacity " then local n = safeNum(low:sub(9)) if not n or n < 0 or n > 100 then echo("[Portrait] opacity takes 0-100.", "#ff6666") return end panelAlpha = math.floor(n) / 100 saveSettings() applyAlpha() safeRender() elseif low:sub(1, 5) == "name " then local n = trimBoth(cmd:sub(6)) if n == "clear" then nameOverride = "" echo("[Portrait] name back to what score reports.", GOLD) else nameOverride = n sc.name = n echo("[Portrait] name set to " .. n .. ".", GOLD) end saveSettings() safeRender() elseif low == "diag" then printDiag() else echo("[Portrait] portrait show | hide | sheet | portrait", GOLD) echo(" portrait avatar <https url>|clear", GOLD) echo(" portrait name <name>|clear", GOLD) echo(" portrait opacity <0-100> | diag", GOLD) end end, "Character portrait") end function onConnect(sessionId) negoConnected = true negoTick = 0 primed = false vit = nil safeRender() end function onDisconnect(sessionId) negoConnected = false end -- Score is read, never altered: nothing is gagged and nothing is rewritten. function onLine(sessionId, rawLine, cleanLine) local ok, err = pcall(function() if feedScore(trimBoth(cleanLine)) then safeRender() end end) if not ok then lastError = tostring(err) inScore = false end return nil end function cleanup() end
